_comment: Cache-safe temporal E2E (gemini). Two-run cross-turn pattern with >=3s gap so the volatile temporal suffix DIFFERS between turns, while the stable system prefix stays cacheable. Expect run1 cache_write>0, run2 cache_read>0. Run: `set -a; source .env; set +a; unset ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; SESS=tmp_gemini_$(date +%s); ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_temporal_gemini_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info; sleep 3; ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_temporal_gemini_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info`
